record_type_quote: We performed two direct replications of this experiment using Japanese participants.

targets.title: Hierarchical encoding makes individuals in a group seem more attractive.
targets.evidence_quote: We replicated Walker and Vul’s Experiment 4, which manipulated group size.
targets.outcome_quote: While the sample sizes in the present experiments were 2.5 and 4.1 times as large as that of previous study, we did not obtain significant main effects. This thing suggests that the sample size in the present experiments did not prevent significant main effects. The very small effect sizes also suggest no cheerleader effect in the present study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Both experiments are described as failing to replicate; the general discussion concludes that the very small effects suggest no cheerleader effect. Similarity in the pattern in Experiment 2 does not overturn this overall verdict.

reasoning: Full four-page article including references verifies identity and contains two new-sample replications of Experiment 4 of a single original paper. The DOI of the original is not printed.
